headline: Sunday evening, and the beach lane was checked again a few minutes ago — every Dauphin Island and Gulf Shores home on this board is still active at exactly the price shown, with nothing pending, under contract or sold. Three more Dauphin Island houses came up in tonight's sweep but all are two-bedrooms, so they stay off a board built for 3-bedroom rental houses. Nashville and Knoxville stay frozen — their listing sites have refused us seven times running and the next attempt is Thursday morning.
